import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Standardize island labels (case/space variants)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert flipper length to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix sign errors: negative values whose absolute value is in range
    neg_mask = df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0
    abs_vals = df.loc[neg_mask, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    valid_abs = abs_vals.between(170, 235)
    df.loc[valid_abs.index, 'flipper_length_mm'] = abs_vals[valid_abs]
    
    # Mark any remaining out-of-range values as missing
    df.loc[~df['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    valid = cleaned.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    means = valid.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().round(2)
    return means.to_dict()
